title: DSPy General Utilities
summary: This module provides a collection of essential utility functions for DSPy, including tools for managing asynchronous and synchronous execution, handling callbacks, downloading files, and providing dummy implementations for testing and development.

nodes.label: Wrap Sync Program for Async
nodes.title: Async Program Wrapper
nodes.description: Converts a synchronous program into an awaitable asynchronous function, managing thread-local context and concurrency for safe execution in an async environment.

nodes.label: Manage Thread-Local Context
nodes.title: Thread-Local Context Manager
nodes.description: An internal helper function used by `async_program` to correctly set and reset thread-local context overrides around the execution of the original synchronous program.

nodes.label: Control Async Concurrency
nodes.title: Asynchronous Concurrency Limiter
nodes.description: Provides and manages a concurrency limiter (`CapacityLimiter`) to control the number of concurrent asynchronous operations, preventing resource exhaustion.

nodes.label: Add Callbacks to Async Function
nodes.title: Async Callback Wrapper
nodes.description: A decorator-like function that wraps an asynchronous function, injecting pre- and post-execution callback logic, and managing a call ID for tracing and context.

nodes.label: Add Callbacks to Sync Function
nodes.title: Sync Callback Wrapper
nodes.description: A decorator-like function that wraps a synchronous function, injecting pre- and post-execution callback logic, and managing a call ID for tracing and context.

nodes.label: Convert Async Program to Sync
nodes.title: Async to Sync Program Wrapper
nodes.description: A class that wraps an asynchronous program (`Module`) to expose a synchronous `forward` method, allowing it to be called seamlessly in synchronous contexts.

nodes.label: Execute Async in Thread (anyio)
nodes.title: anyio.to_thread.run_sync
nodes.description: An external utility from the `anyio` library that runs an asynchronous function in a separate thread, blocking the calling thread until its completion.

nodes.label: Manage Thread-Specific Settings
nodes.title: Thread-Local Settings Manager
nodes.description: A mechanism to store and retrieve settings or context that are specific to the current execution thread, ensuring isolation and proper context propagation.

nodes.label: Retrieve Active Callbacks
nodes.title: Active Callbacks Retriever
nodes.description: An internal utility function responsible for fetching the list of currently active callback functions associated with a given instance.

nodes.label: Execute Pre-Call Callbacks
nodes.title: Pre-Call Callback Executor
nodes.description: An internal utility function that iterates through and executes registered callback functions before the main wrapped function is invoked.

nodes.label: Execute Post-Call Callbacks
nodes.title: Post-Call Callback Executor
nodes.description: An internal utility function that iterates through and executes registered callback functions after the main wrapped function has completed or raised an exception.

nodes.label: Track Current Call ID Context
nodes.title: Active Call ID Context
nodes.description: A thread-local context variable used to store and retrieve the unique identifier for the currently executing function call, primarily for callback tracing and context management.

nodes.label: Execute Async Coroutine Sync
nodes.title: Synchronous Async Runner
nodes.description: An external utility function that blocks the current thread until a given asynchronous coroutine completes, effectively running async code in a synchronous manner.

nodes.label: Download File
nodes.title: File Downloader
nodes.description: Downloads a file from a given URL, checking if it already exists and its size to avoid re-downloading unnecessary data.

nodes.label: Mark Experimental Features
nodes.title: Experimental Feature Decorator
nodes.description: A decorator used to mark functions or classes as experimental, providing a mechanism for managing feature development and deprecation.

nodes.label: Dummy Language Model
nodes.title: Simulate LM for Testing
nodes.description: Provides a mock language model for unit testing, supporting various response modes like predefined lists, dictionary lookups, or example following to simulate LM behavior without actual API calls.

nodes.label: Dummy Retriever Logic
nodes.title: Simulate Retrieval Logic
nodes.description: An internal function within a dummy retriever (likely `DummyRM` not shown here) that simulates document retrieval based on vector similarity for testing purposes.

nodes.label: Base LM Interface
nodes.title: Base Language Model Interface
nodes.description: The foundational abstract class for all language models in DSPy, defining the common interface for LM operations.

nodes.label: Chat Adapter
nodes.title: Format Chat Messages
nodes.description: Adapts messages and responses to and from a chat-based language model format, handling roles and content structuring.

nodes.label: Requests Library
nodes.title: HTTP Request Utility
nodes.description: A popular Python library for making HTTP requests, used by the download utility for fetching files from the web.

groups.label: Asynchronous Execution Management
groups.title: Asynchronous Execution Management
groups.description: Components responsible for enabling synchronous code to run asynchronously, managing concurrency, and ensuring proper context propagation.

groups.label: Synchronous Execution Management
groups.title: Synchronous Execution Management
groups.description: Components focused on enabling asynchronous programs to be called from synchronous contexts.

groups.label: Callback System
groups.title: Callback System
groups.description: Components that provide a flexible callback mechanism for both synchronous and asynchronous function calls, allowing for pre- and post-execution hooks and tracing.

groups.label: Testing Tools
groups.title: Testing and Mocking Utilities
groups.description: Contains components for simulating external systems like Language Models and Retrievers, crucial for unit testing and development without external dependencies.

groups.label: File Management
groups.title: File Download Utility
groups.description: Provides a utility function for downloading files from URLs, with checks to prevent redundant downloads.

groups.label: Development Tools
groups.title: Developer Annotation Tools
groups.description: Includes decorators for marking code components, such as indicating experimental features, aiding in code maintenance and communication.
